Run a private audit

  1. Keep the licensed archive outside the public documentation folder. Run python tools/audit_asset_archive.py /private/path/2d_game_assets.zip --output /private/audit-output.
  2. The script records exact ZIP paths, sizes, SHA256 hashes and PNG IHDR dimensions, excluding __MACOSX and AppleDouble files from art counts; it never copies PNG bytes into the public manual.
  3. Read each included naming/layout/timing/readme/license file. Enter confirmed frame rectangles/action/facing/layer compatibility into sources/animation-frame-map.json; automatic filename parsing is marked inferred, not authoritative.
  4. Visually inspect body plus clothing/weapon on every page and facing. Record known/inferred/unsupported separately; compare foot pivots and full-outfit masks.
  5. Review creator license terms independently for private game use versus public redistribution. A purchase or creator link alone does not authorize public source sprite redistribution.
  6. Merge only non-pixel metadata into sources, regenerate and rerun validation. Do not change audit status to verified until evidence includes archive hash, exact counts and human guide review.

Distribution boundary

This ZIP contains no third-party sprite PNGs, thumbnails, engine assets, 3D meshes or fonts. Source references and legally reviewed metadata are sufficient for documentation. No paid pack content is copied from the legacy repository or unrelated Library uploads.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
